en: Black‑and‑white vintage image showing a small railway station building with a steep tiled roof and several chimneys. The facade bears the name "STANGE" in large letters, and people are standing on the platform beside benches, lamps, and bicycles. Railway tracks run along the foreground. At the top of the image, printed text reads "Stange Jernbanestation." Trees and a tall chimney are visible in the background.
